personal.name: Mohamed Elnagar
personal.heroSubtitle: Skilled Android Developer with hands-on experience delivering production-grade applications from concept through deployment. Proficient in Kotlin, Room, Paging, Hilt, and Firebase services.
personal.contactHeadline: I’m always open to discussing new opportunities, collaborations, or simply connecting with like-minded people. Feel free to reach out via any of the platforms below!

paragraphs: Hello! I'm Mohamed Elnagar, a skilled Android Developer dedicated to building high-performance, production-grade mobile applications.

With expertise in Kotlin, Jetpack Components, and Hilt, I specialize in delivering robust solutions from concept to deployment. I have a strong focus on Clean Architecture, MVVM, and writing maintainable, testable code.

My experience includes developing complex systems like medical record management, retail POS solutions, and productivity tools. I am passionate about continuous learning and staying ahead of modern Android development trends like Coroutines (Flow/StateFlow) and Paging.
When I'm not coding, I focus on software engineering best practices, exploring multimodule architectures, and refining user experiences through intuitive design and performance optimization.

projects.title: Fard (Islamic Productivity)
projects.description: A high-performance spiritual companion built with Flutter, featuring complex global time automation, background audio, and a multi-engine Quran reader.
features: Modular Clean Architecture & DDD for 100% testability
Global Time Automation via adhan library with custom offsets
System-level media service for background audio & lock-screen controls
Native Android Boot Receivers to reschedule alarms after restart
Immersive Quran reader with multiple text modes and scanned Mushaf
Advanced Qada tracking with cumulative debt management
Dynamic Material 3 Theming Engine: 4 presets + dual-seed palette generation
Native Android components for Home Widgets and background tasks

projects.title: Taaza Today (News & Shorts)
projects.description: A production-ready bilingual news aggregator and short-video platform built with Jetpack Compose and Ktor.
features: Optimized rendering: Achieved <200ms cold-start on Paging 3 feed
Smooth performance: 60 FPS scrolling even on 1GB RAM devices
Bilingual support (Hindi/English) with dynamic runtime switching
Integrated short-video platform and YouTube Android Player
Topic-based personalized push notifications (Firebase)
Accessibility: Full content descriptions and screen reader support

projects.title: Sheet Compute (Attendance)
projects.description: Advanced tracking system with deep Excel integration, automated tardiness calculation, and feature management for enterprise data portability.
features: Robust Excel integration for importing/exporting worker records
Configurable Calendar system for holiday/weekend workday logic
Reactive UI architecture using StateFlow and SafeArgs navigation
Automated rejection reporting for invalid data formats
Detailed history management with Paging 3 (300+ daily records)
Feature management via Firebase Remote Config kill-switch

tasks: Architected a **Multimodule System** using **Product Flavors** to manage three distinct enterprise apps from a unified codebase
Maintained a **98%+ crash-free rate** via rigorous Crashlytics monitoring and Proguard optimization
Developed medical and retail solutions from scratch featuring patient history and real-time billing
Engineered automated **PDF/Image report generation** with native WhatsApp sharing integration
Modernized legacy search engines using **Room-to-MySQL sync** and optimized Paging support
Participated in peer code reviews, enforcing Clean Architecture and SOLID standards
Developed a complete **Employee Attendance Management System** with complex Excel integration
Built validation engines for data import using Apache POI with detailed rejection reporting
Utilized reactive state management (StateFlow) and SafeArgs for crash-resistant navigation
Designed and implemented configurable business logic for holiday and weekend working-day calculations
